option_relations.rationale: The histopathologic findings and clinical presentation are consistent with Tumors of the follicular infundibulum (TFI), but no matching leaf ID is found.
Clear cell hidradenoma is a distinct entity with different histopathologic features.
Clear cell (pale cell) basal cell carcinoma has different clinical and histopathologic characteristics.
Trichoepithelioma is a different condition with distinct histopathologic features.
